notes:
Summary: Starlight builds a JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugin that combines local workspace indexing with server-side model inference to deliver contextual code completions and an in-IDE copilot. They require very low-latency streaming to the IDE (developers expect near-real-time token streaming for completions) and strong control over model versions and fallbacks.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Local indexing: plugin must keep a local index of the repo (LS-style) used to bias completions; index should never leave customer environment.
- Low-latency streaming: target median token latency <50ms for interactive completions; P95 under 150ms.
- Model/version pinning: need to pin a model per-release channel (stable/beta) and ability to rollback quickly.
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant if capacity degrades; deterministic semantics for rerouting.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration for keys, strict data residency for EU customers; cannot leak repo content to any third-party storage. CTO quote: "No raw repo contents leave our VPC — plugin can send tokenized contexts, but we need guarantees and logs."
- Deployment: primarily private VPC for enterprise customers; on-prem option for a few regulated customers.

POC notes (technical):
- Ran hosted baseline with a 6B open model (quantized) to measure streaming latency. Observed median ~45ms token latency on Redwood Dedicated pool in us-west. P95 spikes correlated with autoscaling events.
- Local index integration: prototype sends index fingerprints and compressed symbol vectors; server combines with model context to bias completions. Need guidance on safe hashing/PII approach.
- Model pinning: tested stable vs beta rollout; want API to pin model by SHA+version and a rollout flag for canary users.
- Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to pay for predictable latency. Looking to Optimize recommendations for batching and cache to reduce token cost for frequently-used completions.

Sales/logistics:
- Pricing ask: estimated ARR $100k-$250k for enterprise bundle (private + extra retention).
- Legal: DPA + SOC2 attestation required before procurement finalization.
- Networking: needs detailed VPC peering doc and a short checklist for engineers.
